name: 86 Chaos 16.0.96 Release Gate Workspace Voice Access Verification Fix
label: 86 Chaos 16.0.96 Release Gate Workspace Voice Access Verification Fix
releaseTitle: 86 Chaos 16.0.96 Release Gate Workspace Voice Access Verification Fix
notes: Release-gate preflight now accepts the unique current-run QA workspace name and rejects stale or production names.
QA cleanup now uses current-run IDs, QA ownership markers, and recorded document IDs instead of the obsolete shared workspace name.
Runtime crash reports now expire abandoned in-flight markers so a later crash can still be reported.
86Voice and Speak Reminder microphone lifecycles now prevent duplicate recognition sessions and cancel delayed starts on close or unmount.
